why: Botemania confirms a Jacks-or-Better progressive variant inside Ultimate Video Poker but does not publish that variant's exact paytable or qualifying denomination.

The Botemania product envelope advertises selectable 1/5/10/25 hands and a 0.01 EUR product minimum, while the external comparator is specifically documented as 10 hands at 0.25 denomination; the public operator page does not prove that its progressive sub-variant inherits or matches those comparator settings.

A 7/5-shaped visual paytable or matching game name is insufficient to transfer a break-even threshold without exact royal award, denomination, hand-count/jackpot accounting and qualifying-stake fingerprint.

requiredForExactSpainEV: Exact in-game Jotas o Mejor Progresivo paytable at the jackpot-qualifying setting
Exact credit value / denomination that qualifies for the progressive jackpot
Whether the displayed progressive award is per hand or shared across the selected multi-hand wager
Exact number of simultaneously played hands at the qualifying setting
Royal Flush probability under the jackpot-optimal strategy for that exact paytable and jackpot value
Progressive reset/base award and current jackpot-to-credit conversion
Rules fingerprint proving the WAGER_BET live meter belongs to this exact Botemania progressive variant
